spans.s:
भूनाग m. (-गः) An earth-worm.
 E. भू the earth, and नाग a snake.

भूनिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A species of gentian, commonly cheraytā, (Gentiana
cheraytā, Rox.)
 E. भू the earth, and निम्ब the Nimba tree.

भूनय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or consisting the earth.
 f. (-यी) A name
of Chāyā or shadow personified, the wife of the sun.
 E. भू earth,
and मयट् aff.
